semantic_fidelity.reason: All 13 required concept identities appear across the actual captures, paid-only products are absent, source 283/284 corrections override the historical oob->nvos relation, one three-way OOB split exists, host tags avoid GPU-die residency, and the dashed host-local edge does not assert deploys/manages. However F01 drops required SSH/SFTP and clear NVUE REST protocol coverage from the RMS NVOS/NMX control relation. F09 leaves the required off-rack management location implicit: mgmt is a role, not an explicit off-rack placement. No unchanged-label or mandatory residency-enclosure requirement is invented.

arrow_traceability.reason: The fourteen destination arrows are visually traceable; the OOB bus has one genuine junction at (32,32), bridge (32,30) is distinguishable from a connection, labels have zero uncertain owners, and no false OOB->DCGM/NVOS edge is invented. F02 is an avoidable Power branch detour, and F03 makes the six animated arrows fail the explicit origin/direction gate despite readable static heads.

layout_fit.reason: Every required node box and diagram label fits 77x47 at natural 100%; app header tokens and separate 79x49 pane probe support actual target fit. Two quit hints, not diagram labels, truncate. Nonetheless the one avoidable v1 bridge in F02 fails crossing minimization; it is confirmed by crossings: 1 bridges, 0 touching bends. v2/v3 each have zero bridges/touching-bend collisions. No label was dropped or source group reordered to lower crossings.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Normal ANSI shows related in-rack hardware endpoints in one hue family and close placement; v2 NVOS/NMX-C/T share another family; v3 Kubernetes/GPU Operator share warm hues and host software shares teal hues. The groups follow source roles, not geometric depth. Absent region enclosures are not themselves forbidden by the rubric; host/tray/mgmt tags and hosting edges carry residency. Cross-view hue or identical controller-label stability is not a gate.

border_integrity.reason: ANSI cell-by-cell perimeter audit confirms all sides/corners complete and a single consistent per-node normal border RGB for 17/17 node occurrences. The three select-all ANSI captures show all 17 full perimeters in bold RGB (216,166,87), without route contamination. This proves simultaneous selected-border coverage, not individual hover/drag behavior or unseen states.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen skill, executable, rubric, dataset, case-source/expected/variants and capture artifact hashes verify; independent Sol stage-A record is immutable and predates reveal; generator is the required DeepSeek model. F05 breaks binding of the named final v2 spec to captured evidence. F06/F07/F08 leave exact rejected command/status, initial-frame provenance and a claimed fifth pane cleanup incomplete. Validator passes do not repair these gaps or override captured origin/detour defects.

animation.reason: Optional source animation is not N/A after six routes actually animate. v1 is legitimately static, one dot per route remains sparse in v2/v3, initial samples show shared eligible-cell progress, and no captured dot covers a label/border/corner/bridge/head. F03 gives six observed origin violations against check 4/4+2/2 claims; F04 leaves full-cycle behavior unproven. The default is constant speed, not synchronized arrival: no same-arrival requirement is imposed.

findings.description: DEFECT: required NVSwitch southbound protocol coverage is abbreviated away. The only captured rms->NVOS label is NVUE/NMX gRPC: SSH/SFTP is absent and NVUE REST is not explicitly distinguished from NMX-C gRPC. generation.json acknowledges dropping SSH/SFTP for width. A ledger entry admitting a drop does not preserve the required protocol in the visible artifact. Endpoints and direction are otherwise correct.

DEFECT (also fails layout_fit): the Power shelf branch is traceable but needlessly loops back across the incoming OOB rail. From the one junction (32,32) it goes west to (30,32), north to (30,30), east through bridge (32,30) to (54,30), then south to head (54,33). This is 31 grid steps versus endpoint Manhattan distance 23. No node obstacle occupies that detour zone; a single junction with the left arm assigned to NVSwitch, downward arm to Compute and right arm to Power can avoid the bridge without reordering nodes or source tiers. The one-split demand IS satisfied; it does not excuse avoidable route geometry. The 1/1 route-economy check counts the ordinary edge, not the three trunk destination paths.

DEFECT (also fails arrow_traceability): all six animated routes start one drawn cell past their true origins in frame 0. v2 first exterior cells are (22,14/16/18/20), but dots are at (23,14/16/18/20); v3 origins are (13,19) and (35,27), dots (13,20) and (35,28). This directly contradicts check claims origins 4/4 and 2/2. The rule includes the first drawn cell, not the renderer's internal half-cell phase. Origin failures remain failures despite incomplete later motion evidence.

EVIDENCE GAP: v2 and v3 preserve only 0-2000ms, not a full constant-speed cycle. No dot reaches any destination arrowhead during the target-size samples. v2 frames 0 and 10 show all four dots advancing five eligible straight cells; v3 frames 0 and 10 show both dots advancing five eligible cells after skipping their first corner. This supports sparse shared-rate initial movement but cannot prove the remainder of each route, later forbidden-cell behavior or wrap. Same-arrival was not requested and unequal arrival is NOT a defect. Animation remains fail due to F03, not merely blocked.

DEFECT / evidence-binding blocker: named final v2-mgmt-api.json hashes to ef9dcfb927a6bfdf22eba4d028aad51c48a9abe20771b97e337fe83c669847c1, but all v2 pane captures, check output and manifest bind to v2-mgmt-api-a3.json at ae706bef201671ef2eb665c51b6116d5afdfb3f9ce7151cb620dc8b69fae4000. attempts.json explicitly rejects the named final and ships a3. Therefore v2 was judged on actual a3 captures; these cannot prove the named final's fit, label ownership or source-build qualifier. The blind record identified this before expectations were revealed.

EVIDENCE GAP: attempt specs and raw check text are retained, and the three capture manifests record check_exit=0 plus windows, but exact executed shell commands and separate stdout/stderr/exit records for every rejected/probe attempt are not preserved. The v1-a3 log has an error but no numeric exit status; attempts.json supplies outcomes in prose rather than raw command/status evidence. Binary-path assertions and schematic invocation forms in generation.json are not complete executed command transcripts. This does not erase the visual failures.

EVIDENCE GAP: original v2/v3 frame text and ANSI have a truncated, unheaded first frame. Complete target-size frame 0 comes from supplemental direct dumps; v1's supplemental static dump is not recorded in its original manifest. Review inventory hashes those actual files, but cannot retroactively supply generator-time wall-clock/manifest binding or full-cycle evidence. All available files are readable.

EVIDENCE GAP / cleanup blocker: generation.json claims five created and closed panes (three captures plus two geometry probes). The preserved records identify only four owned pane ids: capture panes w7E:pDN, w7E:pDX, w7E:pDQ and probe w7E:pDY. All four have confirmed-close records, but the asserted second probe has no preserved id or close result. The existing parent pane w7E:pDH is not owned by the generator and must not be counted or closed. No leak is asserted; the fifth cleanup claim is unverified.

DEFECT: off-rack management residency is not explicit in the rendered views. v1 labels the controller nv-rms (mgmt), which names a role, and captured v2 labels it nv-rms (src build), which names availability. The off-rack mgmt group string and view title exist only in spec/ledger metadata, not the capture. Host and tray residency are readable elsewhere. Enclosures are not mandated; a source-backed location label or visible caption could satisfy the missing placement fact without adding containers.
